title: Holiday spending abroad, flagged then cleared
summary: A customer travelling overseas made several payments from an unfamiliar location. Amounts were modest and the travel time between locations was physically plausible.
signals: the payment was made in a city this customer has not transacted from before
the amounts are in line with this customer's normal spending
the distance travelled is physically possible in the time elapsed
resolution: Customer confirmed. Later payments on the trip were approved without challenge.
lesson: A new location alone is weak evidence. It matters only when the travel is physically impossible, or when it arrives with other signals.
